_comment: Manual price corrections, applied last. Use this for the client's returned 'Prix corrigé' column and for defects in the store's own data. Match on 'name' (exact product name after the split) or 'sku'. Every entry needs a reason so the correction can be audited later.

overrides.name: Zénith — Canapé
overrides.reason: Typo in the store's Shopify data: the variant reads $200 while the suite's own loveseat is $1,500 and its armchair $900. Two independent checks give $1,800 — the set arithmetic (4200 - 1500 - 900) and every sibling suite with a $4,200 set (Royal, Véga, Sérénity), all of which price the canapé at $1,800.
